mapper.select: SELECT 'COLOR' AS group_code, c.v AS code, count(*) AS count FROM tb_user_profile p CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(p.colors) AS c(v) GROUP BY c.v UNION ALL SELECT 'STYLE', m.v, count(*) FROM tb_user_profile p CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(p.moods) AS m(v) GROUP BY m.v UNION ALL SELECT 'AGE_RANGE', age_range, count(*) FROM tb_user_profile WHERE age_range IS NOT NULL GROUP BY age_range UNION ALL SELECT 'BODY_TYPE', body_type, count(*) FROM tb_user_profile WHERE body_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY body_type UNION ALL SELECT 'FIT', fit_preference, count(*) FROM tb_user_profile WHERE fit_preference IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fit_preference
